content:
[L] high | Campaign list rows | The cursor overlays and clips the "Check-in — How is it going?" title text inside the dark pill, obscuring the campaign name.
[S] high | Campaign report card | The report card occupies only ~55% of the width, leaving a large empty dead zone on the right half of the window with nothing in it.
[H] high | Campaign rows | Campaign titles ("Spring push", "Check-in") render as small, low-contrast grey text with no heading weight, so rows read as undifferentiated debug output rather than scannable records.
[C] high | Campaign report | The report is a raw key/value dump ("recipients", "sent", "reply_rate" with literal underscore naming) exposing internal field names instead of a designed stats summary.
[C] high | Campaign rows | Buttons "queue", "pause", "resume", "cancel remaining", "retry failed" are all shown simultaneously on every row regardless of state, a control dump that professional products gate by status.
[H] med | Campaign row 1 vs 2 | Row 1 title is plain text while row 2 title is a dark filled pill — inconsistent treatment of the same element type between sibling rows.
[H] med | Campaign rows | Status badges ("completed", "draft") are lowercase, tiny, and faint grey-on-grey, failing to communicate status at a glance.
[S] med | Row 1 vs Row 2 | Row 1 has no "Edit" button while row 2 does, shifting the "queue/pause/resume" button cluster horizontally and breaking alignment between the two rows' action rows.
[S] med | Campaign report | Label/value pairs have huge uneven vertical gaps (~40px per row) for a two-row data set, wasting vertical space while the top rows are cramped.
[H] med | Tab bar | Inactive tabs "Segments" and "Do not contact" are very low-contrast grey and nearly unreadable.
[S] med | Report footnote | The explanatory footnote text runs edge-to-edge inside the card with no clear separation from the stats above it, reading as an afterthought.
[C] med | Entire screen | No pagination, filtering, or search affordances for campaigns; the list is a bare unstyled stack.
[C] med | Footer area | Below the report card the screen dead-ends with a hard black band and unresolved grey emptiness — unfinished-looking bottom edge.
[H] low | Red buttons | Destructive "cancel remaining" is rendered at the same visual weight as the non-destructive "retry failed" beside it, with no confirmation hierarchy.
[C] low | Toolbar | The "+ New Campaign" button sits alone in a vast grey band with a full-width hairline divider directly beneath it, creating a cramped two-layer chrome region.

VERDICT: unprofessional — a half-width key/value debug dump, state-inappropriate control dump on every row, and inconsistent row treatments that no commercial helpdesk would ship.
